5_validation_falsification.reason: External pilot data WERE found and compared. The model is an EQUILIBRIUM model; the lab data are KINETIC at 1-10 bar, so the mean bias is +0.287 X_CH4. A commercial Ni/MgAl2O4 catalyst datasheet, a design-point pilot campaign, a 200-1000 h sintering series and a certified HAZOP are still absent. The methanol kinetic model reproduces two opened benchmarks. The ammonia model was rebuilt as a multi-bed adiabatic converter and now needs ONE documented activity scalar (k_scale=0.213) to sit on the opened per-pass benchmark; the two opened ammonia benchmarks themselves disagree by a factor of 2.36 on that scalar, so this is calibration, not validation.

external_data.interpretation: A positive bias is EXPECTED: the model solves chemical EQUILIBRIUM, whereas the lab data are KINETIC (short contact time, 1-10 bar). This comparison FALSIFIES the use of the equilibrium model as a kinetic predictor; it does not validate the design-point equilibrium.
